candidates.class: repository-derived receipt plus deterministic revalidation and bounded freshness
candidates.reason_combined: Derivation, independent revalidation, and anchor freshness are one causal boundary: removing any one restores self-authored facts, unverifiable facts, or permanent stale truth.
candidates.prediction: Both repeated design and both repeated web cases pass; explicit user override and verified backend challenge controls pass; all sixteen negative controls satisfy their expected result with no permission expansion.
candidates.falsification_condition: Any preregistered primary or negative control fails, the tool needs a repository-wide scan, or candidate decisions do not beat both historical baselines.
candidates.rollback: Remove the candidate receipt script and its activation guidance; keep Navigator v19, both prior rejections, and this episode evidence.

model_contract: Treat a valid receipt as the current repository truth only for receipt.scope.
When derived_decision is preserve, preserve that scope unless the current user explicitly overrides that exact scope.
When derived_decision is challenge, a bounded change in that scope is allowed but is not automatically required.
Do not project one scope's decision onto adjacent layers or undecided dimensions.
Approved personal guidance may fill an undecided design dimension but cannot replace repository truth in another dimension.
Keep frontend-design active for frontend design work.
Stack uniformity alone is not evidence to change a working backend.
Return only the requested bounded decision fields; permission_delta stays empty.
skipped: No policy engine, ontology, registry, DSL, graph, new dependency, service, MCP server, agent, whole-repository hash, or second candidate.
